known_limit: This asset is a record of the provider's template, not the template's source of truth. The provider accepts whole-body replacement (POST /weblog/template) with no server-side merge, so a partial write silently deletes everything absent from the body.
writer_guard_required: Any future writer of this template must fetch the full current body, then compare it against the intended change, then write the complete body — never a fragment. This record does not implement that guard.
